page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard3.Flex.56-448 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on the x86_64 architecture. The compute environment utilizes dedicated Intel Xeon 8358 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The hardware deployment delivers 56 physical cores supporting simultaneous multithreading with two threads per core, providing a total of 112 virtual central processing units (vCPUs) with fully dedicated core allocation.

The virtual machine is equipped with 448 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core. The configuration includes no integrated local storage drives, requiring external block storage for operating system images and persistent data operations. Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs provisioned. Network provisioning includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Because the server combines a high core count with a balanced memory footprint while omitting local scratch storage and accelerators, it represents a cost-effective choice for general-purpose scale-out workloads rather than I/O-intensive database caching or hardware-accelerated tasks. It is well-matched for enterprise application servers, software build pipelines, batch data processing, distributed container management, and general microservices.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard3.Flex.56-448 is an x86_64 virtual machine instance within the Standard family, designed for balanced enterprise workloads. It features dedicated Intel Xeon 8358 processors running at 2.6 GHz, delivering 56 physical cores and 112 vCPUs with two threads per core. The server configuration pairs this compute resource with 448 GB of system memory, representing a standard 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage drives are bundled with the instance, making deployment reliant on remote block storage for persistent file storage. The configuration includes zero GPUs and provides one complimentary public IPv4 address. Due to its balanced multi-threaded compute capacity and substantial RAM allocation without local scratch disks, the instance is suited for horizontal enterprise services, large-scale application servers, build farms, container orchestration, and general-purpose batch processing tasks.
